text: 1st Semester (5 Months Theoretical): Tuition: 12,000 RMB (3,400 RMB/Month) Interpretation Fee: 4,500 RMB (900 RMB/Month) Subtotal: 16,500 RMB 2nd Semester (1 Month Theoretical and 3 Months Clinical Practice): Tuition: 16,000 RMB (3400 x 1 + 4200 x 3 = 16,000) Interpretation Fee: 7,500 RMB (900 x 1 + 2200 x 3 = 7,500) Subtotal: 23,500 RMB Note: Interpretation fee is only charged when the teacher gives lessons in English. Certificate is confer on the student who have completed all courses of study. Students could choose to be taught in Chinese and the university will arrange you to study with Chinese students together. Students need to choose courses by themselves and 32 RMB/class hour (50 minutes per class hour).
